about: F46: a small mod cell whose scene list ends with the GIANT birth scripts (scr_slot_h_giant_birth, _birth_ej) breeds and gives birth in the same cell. Before, only the GIANT cell (h_type 37) jumped to its birth step when the monster left a pregnant captive, so a mod cell's scene ended after the ej. A captive pregnant with a wolf (harness_type_a) in BREED BIRTH CELL (harness_breed_birth, h_type 9301) gives birth there: the wolf count of monster class 0 becomes 1.
